_meta.note: Photography guidance for AI-assisted rice disease identification. Capture the recommended plant parts for the top-2 predicted classes, merge duplicate shots, and ask for expert confirmation when symptoms overlap.

generic: Take photos in good daylight, keep the camera steady and the affected area in focus. Avoid shadows and glare. Include both a close-up and a wider view when possible. Do not detach or handle plants unnecessarily.
unclear: We could not clearly identify the rice plant or the affected area. Please retake the photo in good daylight with the affected leaf, shoot, insect, or panicle in focus. Include one close-up and one photo showing the whole plant.
